description: This Python script manages fetching and updating VNDK snapshot versions for an Android development environment. It maps version numbers to branch names, retrieves latest build identifiers, and performs updates accordingly. The script includes command-line argument parsing for specifying versions, remote repository, and verbosity.

methods.name: fetch_and_update_snapshots(versions, args)
methods.description: Iterates over given versions, verifies support, logs progress, retrieves latest build ID, and calls update.run to perform the update.

methods.name: get_args(parser)
methods.description: Defines and returns command-line arguments parser with options for versions, all, use-current-branch, remote, and verbosity.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Main execution function; sets up argument parsing and logging, determines which snapshots to fetch based on args, and calls fetch_and_update_snapshots accordingly.
